title: Affiliate manager to C-suite: why partners are your education and breadth is your launchpad
summary: Dustin Howes frames a LinkedIn post and interview with Viktorija Ratomskė around escaping the "affiliate person" label. His own points: partners teach you every channel, networking and adaptability are core skills, and you should keep learning from people below you.

principles.text: Affiliate partners are your best marketing education, because they force you to learn every channel.
principles.quote: You've learned SEO, paid media, content, influencers, and analytics because your partners forced you to understand how every channel works.

principles.text: Learning from partners often beats paid courses for understanding marketing channels.
principles.quote: I would say my partners in the past have taught me the most out of all of the marketing channels and have been the most influential in me learning and growing that education and marketing in general.

principles.text: Adaptability and networking are key traits of a strong affiliate manager.
principles.quote: Adaptability to an environment is one of those keys to a really good affiliate manager and somebody and a good networker, in my opinion.

principles.text: Keep learning from the people beneath you; they research and find new avenues.
principles.quote: keep learning from even the ones that are underneath you.

principles.text: Educate yourself by networking with people who drive traffic in different ways.
principles.quote: educating yourself just by networking with people is a really great practice

principles.text: Keep emotions out of negotiations and stay professional.
principles.quote: Keeping it professional is key to this environment though
